cable.name: Heavy Duty Cable System
cable.description: A sliding cable system with manual or electric operation. Choose mesh for general hauling, or discuss vinyl for weather-sensitive and hot-mix applications.
cable.note: Ask the team to confirm dimensions, motor choice and installation requirements for your vehicle.
details: The company’s Anti Pollution System uses mesh for general hauling where weather protection is not the priority, including dirt, sand and gravel.

The published Semi-Waterproof System uses vinyl for weather resistance and heat retention. Discuss the load and temperature requirements for asphalt or other sensitive materials; this is not a waterproof guarantee.

Published bow options include 13-inch and 18-inch arches, with custom arches available by request. Reinforced bow pockets and an optional aluminum or diamond-plate wind deflector are described on the company site.

swing.name: HD Swing Arm System
swing.description: A swing arm system with external or underbody mounting configurations and ground-level operating options.
swing.note: These are published size ranges, not an automatic fit recommendation. Confirm mounting, clearance and any configuration outside these ranges with the team.
details: Published for 8–26 ft dump bodies, with polished aluminum arms and a bolt-on spiral torsion spring assembly. Ask the team to confirm mounting space and clearances.
Published for 12–38 ft dump bodies. The lower arm lengths and spring assemblies vary; use the numbered diagram and part markings when requesting replacements.

custom.name: Custom Roll Tarp
custom.description: Custom roll tarps made to the dimensions of your box, with reinforced edges and attachment details to suit the application.
custom.note: Include the intended use and approximate dimensions in your request. Final dimensions, hardware, colors and pricing need confirmation.
details: The published design uses 18 oz. vinyl, reinforced pockets for wooden boards and 2-inch seatbelt webbing at the edges.
Discuss the box dimensions, desired side drop, attachment layout and color. Send a sketch with units and label whether your measurements describe the box or the finished tarp.

aviation.name: Aviation Baggage Cart Curtains
aviation.description: Custom vinyl curtains for aviation baggage carts, made with reinforced webbing and attachment options for the cart opening.
aviation.note: Share the cart opening dimensions, number of curtains and existing attachment arrangement. Final measurements, hardware and production details need confirmation.
details: Photograph the full cart and each opening, including the mounting points and closure. A labeled sketch helps the team distinguish the opening size from the requested finished curtain size.
